why: No major reviewer or authority appears. Ten of twelve results are about self-hosted software (Nextcloud/Seafile/Syncthing) or cloud services rather than NAS hardware, two are empty Zapier entries, and the only page naming actual NAS models is an Amazon-affiliate listicle with no testing, no prices in-text and no Dropbox-replacement framing. A page that picks specific NAS units for a freelancer, compares their sync apps against Dropbox features, and lists current prices would be the only direct answer in the set.
